abstract: Both serum progesterone and serum unconjugated oestradiol-17beta (Oe2) were measured by competitive protein binding assay and radioimmunoassay respectively in 42 cases of unaborted hydatidiform mole. Serum human chorionic gonadotrophin (HCG) was measured by a haemagglutination-inhibition technique. In 26 cases of intact molar pregnancies without theca lutein cysts (TLC), serum progesterone ranged from 18.0 to 289.0 ng/ml with a mean +/- standard error of the mean (SEM) of 65.9 +/- 13.1 ng/ml; serum Oe2 ranged from 4.0 to 37.0 ng/ml with a mean +/- SEM of 17.9 +/- 1.9 ng/ml; serum HCG ranged from 60 to 1920 IU/ml with a mean +/- SEM of 531.5 +/- 105.7 IU/ml. In contrast, 16 cases of intact molar pregnancies with TLC had serum progesterone ranging from 34.1 to 288.0 ng/ml with a mean +/- SEM of 134.1 +/- 2.4 ng/ml; serum Oe2 ranging from 1.7 to 76.3 ng/ml with a mean +/- SEM of 31.5 +/- 5.3 ng/ml; serum HCG ranging from 320 to 2560 IU/ml with a mean +/- SEM 1400 +/- 196.2 ng/ml. The differences between the mean of these three hormones in hydatidiform mole with and without TLC were significant (progesterone: P less than 0.005; Oe2: P less than 0,0125; HCG: P less than 0.005). There was a significant correlation between serum HCG and serum Oe2 (coefficient of correlation r = +0.3565, P less than 0.0125) and between serum Oe2 and serum progesterone (r = +0.3787, P less than 0.0125). There was no significant difference in the mean levels of serum progesterone, Oe2 and HCG in hydatidiform mole with and without subsequent malignant sequelae. The mean ratios of Oe2/progesterone were essentially similar in moles with and without TLC and with and without malignant sequelae. The significance of these findings are discussed.
abstract_ja: 非流産性胞状奇胎42例において、血清プロゲステロンおよび非抱合型エストラジオール-17β（Oe2）を、それぞれ競合タンパク結合法および放射免疫測定法で測定した。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン（HCG）は赤血球凝集阻止法で測定した。黄体嚢胞（TLC）を伴わない完全胞状奇胎26例では、血清プロゲステロンは18.0〜289.0 ng/mlの範囲で、平均±平均の標準誤差は65.9±13.1 ng/mlであった。血清Oe2は4.0〜37.0 ng/mlの範囲で、平均±SEMは17.9±1.9 ng/mlであった。血清HCGは60〜1920 IU/mlの範囲で、平均±SEMは531.5±105.7 IU/mlであった。一方、TLCを伴う完全胞状奇胎16例では、血清プロゲステロンは34.1〜288.0 ng/mlの範囲で、平均±SEMは134.1±2.4 ng/mlであった。血清Oe2は1.7〜76.3 ng/mlの範囲で、平均±SEMは31.5±5.3 ng/mlであった。血清HCGは320〜2560 IU/mlの範囲で、平均±SEMは1400±196.2 ng/mlであった（原文のまま）。3つのホルモンの平均値の差は、TLCの有無で有意であった（プロゲステロン：P<0.005、Oe2：P<0.0125、HCG：P<0.005）。血清HCGと血清Oe2との間（r=+0.3565、P<0.0125）、および血清Oe2と血清プロゲステロンとの間（r=+0.3787、P<0.0125）には有意な相関があった。続発性悪性病変の有無による血清プロゲステロン、Oe2、HCGの平均値に有意差はなかった。Oe2/プロゲステロン比は、TLCの有無および悪性病変の有無にかかわらず、ほぼ同様であった。これらの所見の意義について考察した。
